title: Living world
promise: Wildlife, habitats, and climate-aware local action you can walk to.
introMarkdown:
## Living world

Nature is not only on TV. It is trees, birds, insects, water, and soil near you.

This pathway trains noticing habitats and choosing one climate-aware habit.

supported.coachNote: Start with one plant and one animal they can find.

steady.coachNote: Ask what the habitat provides (food, shelter, water).

fast.coachNote: Ask how human activity changes the habitat.

llm.tutorBrief: Encourage wonder and care. No eco-shaming. No dangerous wildlife contact. Stay local and practical.
